## Load Packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
```

## Data Loading

```{r}
# travel time 
multimodal_travel_time_lsoa <- st_read("data/multimodal_travel_time_lsoa/multimodal_travel_time_lsoa.gpkg")
```

```{r}
# SUHII as lsoa heat exposure
suhii_lsoa <- st_read("data/London_LSOA_LST_SUHI/London_LSOA_LST_SUHI.shp")%>% 
  st_transform(.,27700)
```

```{r}
# IMD score
imd_score <- read.excel("data/File_1_IoD2025_Index_of_Multiple_Deprivation.xlsx")
```

```{r}
# census data

# age by 5 year band
census_age <- read.csv("data/census_2021/TS007A_Age_by_five_year_age_bands.csv")

# disability
census_disability <- read.csv("data/census_2021/TS038_Disability.csv")

# car ownership
census_carownership <- read.csv("data/census_2021/TS045_Car_or_van_availability.csv")

# occupancy rating bedrooms
census_occup_rating_bedrooms <- read.csv("data/census_2021/TS052_Occupancy_rating_for_bedrooms.csv")
```
